# Self-hosted third-party assets

- Instrument Serif v5, regular and italic, is self-hosted under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The licence is stored with the font files in `assets/fonts/instrument-serif/OFL.txt`.
- GSAP and ScrollTrigger are pinned to version 3.15.0 and self-hosted under the GSAP Standard “no charge” licence referenced in the npm package metadata and source headers.

These files replace runtime requests to Google Fonts and jsDelivr. Update the paths and this record together when upgrading either dependency.
